scripts.build: npm run build -w @mba/domain && npm run build -w @mba/functions && npm run build -w @mba/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mba/domain && npm run typecheck -w @mba/functions && npm run typecheck -w @mba/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mba/domain && npm run test -w @mba/domain && npm run test -w @mba/functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-deadlineos --only firestore "npm run test:rules -w @mba/functions"
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build -w @mba/domain && firebase deploy --only firestore
